video.title: Image, Label & Button | Day 134
video.description:
Learn to explain the basic views of a SwiftUI profile screen: Image, Label & Button, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Image - A view that shows a picture or an SF Symbol.
Label - A view that shows an icon together with a title.
Button - A view that the user taps to run some code.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 134 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

#Shorts #iOSDev #Swift #LearnEnglish

landscape.title: SwiftUI Image, Label & Button | Day 134
landscape.description:
Explain Image, Label & Button in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
이미지, 레이블, 버튼 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Image - A view that shows a picture or an SF Symbol.
한국어: 이미지: 사진이나 SF 심볼을 보여 주는 뷰

Label - A view that shows an icon together with a title.
한국어: 레이블: 아이콘과 제목을 함께 보여 주는 뷰

Button - A view that the user taps to run some code.
한국어: 버튼: 사용자가 탭하면 코드를 실행하는 뷰

In this video, Mina and Jake build a profile screen, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

{{CHAPTERS}}

Comment your quiz answers (1/2/3), I reply to every comment.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Image, Label and Button in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I need an avatar on the profile screen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use an Image. Give it the asset name, like `avatar` in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can an Image also show an icon?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, but for an icon with text, I prefer a Label.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A Label shows an icon and a title together. An Image shows only the picture.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now I need a Save button.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Button. The first argument is the title, and the closure runs on tap.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I tapped the Button, but nothing changed on screen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Your closure only prints. Add real code there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I put a Label inside a Button?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A Button with a Label is a very common pattern. Then the Image stays for photos.
Show the photo in an Image.
